name: Reflectionbot
description: The web crawler of Reflection AI, which visits publicly available pages to help build and improve the company's open models. Its bot page is unusually complete for an AI crawler: it names the single user-agent token the crawler uses, tells site owners to match on that token rather than the whole string, publishes the crawler's address ranges as a JSON feed, and states that the addresses reverse-resolve under the operator's own domain.
